List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on

(Ministries: Earth Sciences; Food Processing Industries; Human Resource
Development; Law and Justice; Mines; Minority Affairs; New and
Renewable Energy; Power; Science and Technology; Social
Justice and Empowerment; Tribal Affairs; Women and
Child Development)
Total number of questions — 20
Functioning of FPIs in NER
†*361. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of FOOD
PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of food processing
industries functioning in North-Eastern
States as on date, State-wise;
(b) the actual position, including profit/
loss, of these industries for each year during
the last three years; and
(c) the policy adopted by Government
to convert the industries running in losses
into profit making ones?
Opening of Kendriya Vidyalayas
†*362. SHRI KRISHAN LAL
BALMIKI: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to open new Kendriya Vidyalayas in the
country during the Eleventh Five Year Plan;
(b) if so, the State-wise details thereof;
(c) the number of out of the above
schools for which process of opening has
been started; and
(d) by when the construction of these
schools will be completed?
Minority community living below
poverty line
*363. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
SHRI MOTIUR RAHMAN:
Will the Minister of MINORITY
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the total number of minority
community population living below
poverty line in the country, State-wise;
(b) the total number of minority
population living below lower middle class
population in the country, State-wise; and
(c) the steps being taken by
Government for their upliftment and
progress in the day to day life during the
Eleventh Five Year Plan period?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

114
Supreme Court's direction on filling
up of vacant posts of judges
*364. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of LAW AND
JUSTICE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Supreme Court directed
on April 3, 2006 that most of the States
have so far failed to put in place a
mechanism to speedily determine and fill
up vacancies of judges at all levels of
judiciary;
(b) if so, whether the Union
Government has taken up this seriously
and has urged the States to recommend the
mechanism for speedy determination and
filling up of vacancies of judges at all levels
of judiciary; and
(c) if so, to what extent the Union
Government has agreed to help and assist
the States in filling up the vacancies of the
judges?
Lowest literacy districts in A.P.
*365. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that eight districts
of Andhra Pradesh have been identified as
having the lowest literacy rate;
(b) if so, the details of such districts;
(c) whether the above districts have
been identified under Special Literacy Drive
launched in April, 2005; and
(d) if so, to what extent this drive would
help to bring the above districts out of
'lowest literacy' tag?
Caste-specific UGC schemes
*366. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether UGC has launched,
formulated, announced numerous caste-
specific fellowships, scholarships, grants,
financial aid, subsidies for individual
scholars and students and teachers in the
fiscal year  2006-07;
(b) the tabulated figures, numbers,
categories and other details for such schemes
of UGC related to caste-specific people in
2006-07;
(c) to what extent caste-specific
bonanzas will hurt minorities and their
educational aspirations; and
(d) the steps proposed to study the
long term impact of excluding minorities
from recent caste-specific bonanzas of
UGC?
Privatization of power distribution
*367. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
Will  the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that even after four
years of power privatization, Government
have not been able to produce desired results
in the Capital and the menace of inflated
bills and fast running meters are persisting;
(b) whether it is also a fact that
administration is not at all prepared to take
into account consumers' points of view;
(c) whether Government are taking any
steps to make Capital free from  power-
cut and no further increase in tariff;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?

115
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Opening of IIT, Kharagpur campus in
Orissa
*368. SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY:
MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the IIT, Kharagpur
proposes to open a campus in Orissa;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the time-frame within which the
campus would be opened?

Upgradation of Meteorological Centre
at Imphal
2724. SHRI RISHANG KEISHING:
Will the Minister of EARTH SCIENCES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
meteorological office at Imphal has remained
without  any upgradation since its inception;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have a policy
to upgrade the meteorological centre; and
(d) if so, the manner in which the
Government would undertake the work?
Establishment of early warning
system for Tsunami
†2725. SHRI AMIR ALAM KHAN:
Will the Minister of EARTH SCIENCES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
establishing early warning system for
tsunami and tempest;
(b) whether an interim tsunami warning
centre has been established in Indian
National Centre for Ocean Information
Service (INCOIS) for tsunami warning;
(c) whether it is a fact that an automatic
tide measuring instrument has also been
established near Indian coast line; and
(d) the steps being taken by
Government to establish communication
system between tide measuring instrument
through INSAT and INCOIS based early
warning system in order to prevent any
emergency crisis?
Participation in fairs and exhibitions
2726. SHRI KAMAL AKHTAR: Will
the Minister of EARTH SCIENCES be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of fairs and exhibitions
held and those in which the Ministry had
participated since forming of the separate
Ministry;
(b) the details of the expenditure
incurred thereon, exhibition-wise;
(c) whether Government are aware that

625
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
there have been wide spread corruption and
financial irregularities in the money spent
on these fairs;
(d) whether Government are also aware
that officials responsible with the fairs and
exhibitions have amassed disproportionate
assets due to this; and
(e) if so, the action proposed/taken
against such corrupt officers who have
misused the public money to their personal
interest?
Expansion in FPIs
†2727. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
Will the Minister of FOOD
PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a wide
expansion has taken place in food
processing industries in the country during
the last three years; and
(b) if so, the number of industries
belonging to big business houses and big
foreign companies in the country which
have launched the production units under
this industry by March, 2006?
Financial assistance for cold storage
2728. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the details of financial assistance
provided for setting up cold storages under
various schemes;
(b) the amount spent on these schemes
during the last three years, State-wise;
(c) whether Government have any
proposal to review these schemes under
the Eleventh Five Year Plan period to
increase allocation of funds; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Grants to FPIs
†2729. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
Will the Minister of FOOD
PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have
implemented the scheme to provide grant
to the food processing industries;
(b) if so, the comprehensive outlines of
implementation of the scheme;
(c) the names of organizations through
which this grant is provided instead of
providing directly to the industrial units;
and
(d) on what basis such organizations
are selected?
Machinery for food processing
industries
2730. SHRIMATI JAYA
BACHCHAN: Will the Minister of FOOD
PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether there are any areas in the
food processing for which machinery is not
available in the country;
(b) whether there has been any import
of machinery from abroad for food
processing industries hitherto unavailable
in the country in the last two years;
(c) whether any steps have been taken
for improving the quality of food processing

626
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
or covering new areas in the last two years;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Food processing sector in Tamil Nadu
2731. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
bring reforms in food processing sector
especially in Tamil Nadu;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the incentives proposed to be
provided to the industry including credit
package, exemption from taxes, etc.?
